question.text: Stamp duty on issuance of equity shares is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the uniform stamp-duty regime introduced by Finance Act 2019 (effective July 2020), the rate on issuance of equity shares is 0.005% and on transfer of equity shares (delivery basis) is 0.015%. These are collected centrally via stock exchanges/depositories. The Trap: 0%, 1%, and 5% do not correspond to the prescribed equity stamp-duty rates; flat percentages of that scale would apply only to certain non-securities instruments. Note: The specific 0.005% issuance and 0.015% transfer stamp-duty rates are not stated in the cited PMS workbook, which only mentions stamp duty as part of brokerage and transaction costs. The framing above reflects the general Indian Stamp Act amendments under Finance Act 2019 rather than a direct workbook citation.
